messages:
daria_support: Hey team — Customer 'ACME Corp' escalated: console shows region=eu-west-1 for their workspace but our access logs/serving metrics show most requests hitting us-east-1. Billing alerts also fired. Can someone triage?

ops-bot: IncidentAlert: route_mismatch spike (12 events) in channel support · triggered at 2026-03-15T08:03:00Z · severity: medium

nate_cs: Customer reports high p95 latency (≈420ms) vs normal (~80ms). They've pasted a curl they ran:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-..." \
  -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

Response headers they got: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-served-region: us-east-1
x-requested-region: eu-west-1
x-request-id: 01FZQ2...abcd
content-type: application/json
```

nate_cs: They also attached trace id 01FZQ2...abcd and sample logs showing connection to node host-ue1-45.us-east.internal

sam_eng-sre: Thanks — can you paste the full request-id + exact timestamps (UTC) for a couple of failed requests? Also include X-Forwarded-For, and whether the customer uses our SDK or direct HTTP.

nate_cs: Provided: request ids [01FZQ2A1abcd, 01FZQ2A2abce] at 2026-03-15T08:02:47Z and 2026-03-15T08:03:11Z. Headers: 
```
X-Region: eu-west-1
X-Forwarded-For: 54.12.34.56
User-Agent: ACME-internal/1.2
```

nate_cs: Also included a short serving log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:02:47Z] request=01FZQ2A1abcd route_decision=fallback_to_pool_us_east reason=eu_pool_full served_node=host-ue1-45.us-east.internal latency_ms=512
[2026-03-15T08:03:11Z] request=01FZQ2A2abce route_decision=normal served_node=host-eu1-12.eu-west.internal latency_ms=86
```

sam_eng-sre: Interesting — one request clearly hit fallback_to_pool_us_east. Could be capacity-triggered fallback. The console UI currently shows the "configured/desired region" (what the customer set) not the actual served region in logs. That mismatch is confusing.

sam_eng-sre: Quick triage plan: (1) check routing.policy logs for the workspace for the last 24h, (2) check eu pool utilization/eviction events around 08:02–08:04, (3) confirm whether routing decision headers are being surfaced in console metrics (they're not right now).

daria_support: Will relay to customer. Do we have a short-term mitigation? They want guaranteed eu serving for a short rollout tomorrow.

sam_eng-sre: Short-term: we can pin the workspace to the eu-reserved pool (manual override) or disable fallback for that workspace (routing.fallback.enabled=false). Both have operational cost. I'll open a private ticket to owners.

billing-bot: FYI — billing attribution uses served_region (x-served-region) for cost; if requests were served from us-east, charges will be billed to consumed_us_east. We'll create a reconciliation ticket and hold any disputed invoices pending investigation.

nate_cs: Customer also asked whether the console should show served region vs requested region. They said it influenced their on-call.

sam_eng-sre: Long-term we should add a visible column/tooltip in the console showing last-served-region and an option to filter by actual serving region in the usage table. Also add x-routing-decision header for easier debugging (if not present).

daria_support: Actions: daria -> update customer (in progress), sam -> check routing.policy + eu pool logs and submit config override request, billing-bot -> open billing-recon ticket. I'll follow up in 1h with status. :thumbsup:

(reacts :eyes:)
